name: Escape Detached HEAD
problem: You checked out a specific commit hash or tag, made some commits, and then realized you are in a 'detached HEAD' state. If you switch branches now, Git will orphan your new commits and they might be garbage collected.

steps.title: Save your commits to a new branch
steps.description: The solution is simple: you just need to give your current state a branch name.
steps.code:
git branch temp-recovery

# Or create and switch in one step:
git switch -c temp-recovery

steps.title: Merge into your target branch
steps.description: Now that your commits are safe on a branch, switch to the branch where they actually belong (e.g., `main`), and merge them in.
steps.code:
git checkout main
git merge temp-recovery

alternatives.title: I already switched branches and lost the commits!
alternatives.description: If you switched branches before creating a new branch, the commits are hidden but not gone. Use the reflog to find them.
alternatives.code:
git reflog

# Look for the hash of your lost commit, then:
git branch recovered-work <hash>
